---
title: See where visitors drop out of signup
description: A funnel sets each stage's width by its value, so the reader sees where most of the audience is lost.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Most visitors leave before signing up

These illustrative figures follow twelve thousand visitors through signup. Each band is as wide as the number of users at that stage; the readout gives the share of the first stage and of the stage before.

```chart
type: funnel
title: Four in ten visitors sign up and one in twenty subscribes
subtitle: Users at each stage, from the first visit to a paid subscription
data:
  inline:
    - stage: Visited
      users: 12000
    - stage: Signed up
      users: 4800
    - stage: Activated
      users: 2900
    - stage: Subscribed
      users: 640
encoding: {x: stage, y: users}
axes:
  y: {label: Users}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each stage's value and how much of the audience it keeps.
